a.lede: Bitget says $387.5 million hack may be linked to North Korean state-backed actors, citing suspicious IP addresses tied to VPN infrastructure previously used by North Korean hacker groups.
a.title: North Korea named as primary suspect in $387 million Bitget crypto hack

b.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget revealed today that attackers who stole $387.5 million last week breached its systems after exploiting a zero-day flaw in third-party security products. [...]
b.title: Bitget hacked via zero-day in third-party security products
